name: Default
shortDescription: Share passwords, text, files and URLs through links that expire after a set number of views or days, with audit logs. Uses SQLite.

alerts.message: This image runs on x86_64 servers only.

Anyone can sign up and no account is an administrator by default. After creating your account, run ./bin/promote_to_admin you@example.com in /opt/PasswordPusher inside the container, then set PWP__DISABLE_SIGNUPS to true and redeploy to close registration. Anonymous visitors can create pushes unless PWP__ALLOW_ANONYMOUS is set to false.
